page.layout: One page of running text in one column. In the right margin, beside the lines "Ho-vetmannos" to "tatos", one marginal note. Below the text, at left, the signature "F 5"; at right, the catchword "rii in". Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: sidium[?], quàm magna in ea vis ad conser-vandam simul sociorum concordiam & judiciorū integritatem, id consilii habuêre ut eam indies sibi devincirent arctiùs. Itaque que sensim concessa civitati aliqua, quæ decori & emolumento ei ipsi, cui tribuebantur, nec tamen detrimento iis, qui tribuebant, esse posse videbantur. Cujus generis illud est vel maximè de Hovet-mannis, quod memorabo postea, non magis honorificum & egregium urbi; quàm ipsis agrariis ob juris & justitiæ ad-ministrationem, & contumaciæ coërci-tionem salutare: item illud de stapulà, uti vocant, rerum ἐπιχωρίων deque negotiationibus & mercatus jure: & illud de cerevisiæ solius Groninganæ in tabernis aut hospitiis publicis usu; quorum alia maturiùs, alia tardiùs initium habuêre. Ho-vetmannos Hovet-manni judices Groningæ primos, de quibus mihi cog-noscere licuit hactenus, vidi in indice notatos sola nomina habente, ad annum Christi M. cccc. x, si memini rectè, qui index in chartophylacio est curiæ urbanæ. Proximos ab his observavi memora-tos in literis publicis Kenonis Broecme-rii in

page.notes: Printed long s throughout written as plain s (e.g. "fenfim" as sensim, "ftapulà" as stapulà). The first word of the page ("fidium") is uncertain: the initial letter is read as a long s, giving "sidium[?]". The Greek word "ἐπιχωρίων" is copied as seen but its accents may not be exact. The Roman numeral "M. cccc. x" is copied as printed. The marginal note has no reference mark in the text; it stands beside the line with "Ho-vetmannos". The Google watermark at the bottom right is not transcribed.
